verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a first-party Figma integration and markets managing design work, which points toward a design-tool connection. The evidence never shows that a designer can update story or project status from inside Figma without switching apps. Missing for 10: documented in-Figma status updates or story editing, details of what the Figma integration actually syncs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps

citations.quote: Manage design work and stay in the loop.
